build_crf_layer: build a CRF layer with num_tags, ignore_index, and default_label_pad_index parameters for sequence labeling
compute_crf_log_likelihood: compute the log-likelihood of emissions and tags using the CRF forward method
decode_crf_viterbi: decode the best tag sequence from emission probabilities using Viterbi decoding
reset_crf_transitions: reset the CRF transition matrix parameters to uniform random values between -0.1 and 0.1
export_crf_to_caffe2: export the CRF layer transitions and operators to a Caffe2 init and predict network
